title: Just uploaded my first game to itch.io let me know what the first impressions are.
author: tenderfather
selftext:
Battletaire is a pvp competitive solitaire game where you play actual solitaire against a CPU or live human. The players share the aces pile as we called it when we were kids (the official rules say foundation). Doing this allows all players to play more cards from their battlefields (tableau piles). When there is only one spot open but both players have the legal card to play it becomes a race of who can place the card first. There are chain reactions that are super satisfying as well. My favorite addition to the game is the reshuffle machine. It sucks up your cards and redeals then on your board. There is a small cool down but you can pretty much spam it if you want. You need all the tricks to beat the computer and I'm pretty fast now too if you see me on there. You can play solo and queue for pvp matches so you can earn up before battle while your friends are getting ready. Use the hints and blaze through the game. How fast can you beat it?

I used Codex mostly for production. One really cool trick I used to get the landing page so crazy was to ask codex to generate interfaces with me for me to show it where I wanted assets to go. Describing layouts is like telling a cat where to sit. Once we made the interface, it was a localhost site that had transformable boxes on it that I could arrange and codex used the Json to reproduce it, then the productivity shoot through the roof. 

I choreographed a while spotlight battle intro just using an interface where codex gave me 4 light sources a start button and a stop button. I picked a light pressed start, dragged it around the screen and codex left a little trail of key frames, the repeated the process 3 more times and in my own version of wwe battle intro lighting. It was awesome. I even had it generate interfaces that provide image editing tools like blur smidge, twining, skewing for placing thumbnails and videos at strange angles and having them show up that way on the webpage was cool. 

Final amazing new workflow was actually playing codex as a player in the pvp. It was genuinely surprised it lost. It was fast too, hahaha better luck next time gpt 5.5

Let me know what you think, free for the foreseeable future www.battletaire.com

https://ryan-keller.itch.io/battletaire
